speaker: Ruben Amorim
quote_text:
Okay, no problem. Really worked so hard to get in  the game at the end of the first half, and then  
the second half just seemed to be complete, aside  from what you've done in the first half. Yeah,  
when we suffered the second goal in the beginning  of the second half, we went down and we need to be  
better in these moments. We need to control  it. We cannot. They are already a really,  
really good team, but then with all the mistakes  that we make during the game help the opponent to  
win confidence and to win the games. Chris. I  mean, it was sad day for Altay letting in four  
goals and that fourth goal was what you were  saying to him as well. I think I'm going to  
continue to do the same. We are going to analyse  the game, but we need to focus on the next one. We  
cannot change this one and the next one is massive  for us. So let's focus on the next one on Thursday  
to play better than to win the game. Ruben,  you obviously made a lot of changes today.  
There was obviously a counter that was a risk  ahead of Thursday. Any regrets about that? No,  
nothing, nothing, because we did mistakes and  they were better. Even if we put a different 11,  
we don't know the results, but then we had to  make choices and we played three days ago, so,  
and you can see with Josh, he was fresh, but he  had some problem, so sometimes we need to make  
choices and then we don't know the results, even  with a different 11. Samuel. When Josh came off,  
did you have to start to prioritise the second  game against Lyon? You made a couple more changes.  
Yes, I will try to. I was waiting for 60 minutes  more or less, but then with one stop I was and  
getting a little bit not afraid, but trying  to avoid any more problems. The goal situation  
with Onana, will you be back in consideration  to start? You have. You guys have to wait. We  
are going to start the next week tomorrow,  and then while I'm going to choose the best,  
the best starting 11 for the next one. Kyle.  This result means another one of the lowest  
Premier League points for the season. How did  Man United go for Wednesday? You said we have  
one extra second on the ball completely. Forget  Newcastle, you didn't have the extra second. No,  
the first part of the question is the reflection  of our season. So we need to accept that and to  
move forward and try to do things so much better  in the future to don't have this kind of season.  
And then you can see some goals that they were  doing high pressure and we lose the possession in  
some moments, in some spaces that we cannot lose  the possession. So we need to improve in a lot of  
things and again, our position is the reflection  of our performance this season, and we have to  
accept. Pete. Hi, Ruben. At time, there was some  decent move that you put together today. Is it can  
you take positives from the better football team?  It's really difficult to look at the best things.  
The best thing is to focus on the next one,  analyse this one, but it's really hard to be here  
after this result and to try to see maybe in few  days I will watch the game and try to take that,  
but in this moment it's really hard to feel to  have any feeling of a good feeling about the game.  
Last question, Rich. What did you make? I think he  did. I think he did quite well. He catch a player  
that is really fast. He made his debut in maybe  one of the hardest stadiums with one team that is  
really in the good moment. I think he did really  well. So he needs to continue and we need to help  
all these young kids to perform in a higher level.  Thank you.​Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.​
title: Ruben Amorim post-match press conference | Newcastle United 4-1 Manchester United
